mechanism_narrative: A current federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the risk-free rate, compressing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.1 percentage points over one month signals an imminent monetary tightening cycle, increasing equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rates and increasing unemployment rates indicates a monetary policy tightening coinciding with labor market weakness, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, high housing starts (HOUST above 550,000 units) and strong GDP growth (GDPC1 above 13,000 billion dollars) signal robust consumer demand and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances when HOUST > 550 and GDPC1 > 13000 in a late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A current unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate hiring, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A current industrial production index above 100 indicates robust manufacturing activity and strong corporate output, supporting earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances when INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: A current level of real personal consumption expenditures above 350,000 million dollars indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate revenues and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances when RSAFS > 350,000.
